_comment: Keyed by HTS prefix. semantic: must | may. 'may' flags become DISCLAIMABLE when any disclaim_if_any phrase appears in the line description, else CONFIRM. Every rule carries the regulation it rests on; verified against agency sources 2026-08-22 (see PLAN.md and docs/DATA_SWAP.md). Extra keys like source are ignored by the engine.

8413.source: 19 CFR 12.74: EPA Form 3520-21 reaches only nonroad/stationary combustion engines incl. equipment containing them; the Aug 2024 form lists only engine categories, so no engine, no form. Filed at entry via ACE/DIS

0306.requirement: FSVP importer data OR seafood-HACCP exemption affirmation (fish under 21 CFR Part 123)
0306.source: 21 CFR 1.501(b)(1): Subpart L does not apply to fish from a Part 123-compliant supplier; 21 CFR 123.12

0306.requirement: Seafood Import Monitoring Program: IFTP holder of record, catch data filed in the ACE entry
0306.source: NOAA SIMP compliance guide (Jan 2024): shrimp covered since 2018-12-31; data filed at entry, chain-of-custody records kept 2 years

9503.requirement: Children's Product Certificate + third-party testing (ASTM F963)
9503.source: CPSA s.14, 15 USC 2063(a)(2); 16 CFR 1110 (certifier = importer, 1110.7(a)); ASTM F963 mandatory via 16 CFR 1250; eCPC filed at entry via ACE since 2026-07-08 (90 FR 1800)

2106.requirement: FSVP importer identification (modified FSVP for dietary supplements)
2106.source: 21 CFR 1.511 (modified FSVP) still requires 1.509 importer name, email and DUNS at entry
21 CFR Part 1 Subpart H (FSMA facility registration)

6912.requirement: Ceramicware extractable lead/cadmium action levels (food-contact surveillance)
6912.source: CPG 545.450 (lead) / 545.400 (cadmium) action levels; enforcement is surveillance and DWPE import alerts, not an entry certificate. Decorative out requires the 21 CFR 109.16 stick-on label plus permanent base statement on the article itself

9405.source: 47 CFR 15.101 table: unintentional radiators are SDoC or certification; compliance records on request (2.1204), no CBP filing since Form 740 eliminated 2017-11-02
10 CFR 429.12: certify via CCMS before distribution in commerce; on-file obligation, not an entry document. 10 CFR 429.57 (general service lamps)

8513.source: 47 CFR 15.101 table: unintentional radiators are SDoC or certification; compliance records on request (2.1204), no CBP filing since Form 740 eliminated 2017-11-02

8504.source: 47 CFR 15.101 table: unintentional radiators are SDoC or certification; compliance records on request (2.1204), no CBP filing since Form 740 eliminated 2017-11-02
10 CFR 429.12: certify via CCMS before distribution in commerce; on-file obligation, not an entry document. 10 CFR 429.37 (external power supplies)

8471.requirement: FCC equipment authorization: SDoC for the digital device; certification for any WiFi/Bluetooth radio
8471.source: 47 CFR 15.201(b): intentional radiators must be certified (typically via certified module); SDoC alone covers only a radio-less machine. Records on request, no entry filing

8501.source: 10 CFR 429.12: certify via CCMS before distribution in commerce; on-file obligation, not an entry document. 10 CFR 429.12 + 431 subpart B (regular electric motors; small-motor provisions never codified)

7318.requirement: AD/CVD scope check: threaded rod orders A-570-932 and A-570-104/C-570-105 are active; no general fasteners order
7318.source: No general steel-fasteners CN order: 2009 petition failed at the ITC (unanimous negative, 2009-11-06). Threaded rod: A-570-932 sunset affirmative May 2025; A-570-104/C-570-105 continued Jun 2025. Lock washers A-570-822 revoked 2022-05-26. Scope is the written description, not the HTS number
